sentences.content: Last week I went to the theatre.
I had a very good seat.
A young man and a young woman were sitting behind me.
sentences.translation: 一个青年男子和一个青年女子坐在我的身后。

sentences.content: I never get up early on Sundays.
sentences.translation: 在星期天我是从来不早起的。

sentences.content: I sometimes stay in bed until lunch time.
sentences.translation: 有时我要一直躺到吃午饭的时候。

sentences.content: Last Sunday I got up very late.
sentences.translation: 上个星期天，我起得很晚。

sentences.content: I looked out of the window.
Pumas are large, cat-like animals which are found in America.
sentences.translation: 美洲狮是一种体形似猫的大动物，产于美洲。

sentences.content: When reports came into London Zoo that a wild puma had been spotted forty-five miles south of London, they were not taken seriously.
sentences.translation: 当伦敦动物园接到报告说，在伦敦以南45英里处发现一只野生的美洲狮时，这些报告并没有受到重视。

sentences.content: However, as the evidence began to accumulate, experts from the Zoo felt obliged to investigate.
sentences.translation: 然而，随着证据越来越多，动物园的专家们感到有必要进行一番调查。

sentences.content: Good morning! How are you today?
I'm fine, thank you. And you?
